jobs.description:
Do you have what it takes to shine as a true forklift hero in the frozen food industry? 

Then we have the perfect challenging position for you! This company, located in Ardooie, is a global player in the development, processing, and marketing of fresh-frozen products such as vegetables, fruit, herbs, and ready-made meals. We need YOU to join our team! 

As a forklift driver working 2 shifts, you'll play a crucial role in our production process. Showcase your talents and embrace the following tasks with pride: 

 
• Confidently and expertly operate the forklift to load, unload, and move goods within the refreshing frozen food environment (-18 degrees Celsius). 
 
• Your precision and care ensure that products are stacked correctly and stored in their designated locations. 
 
• You'll perform warehouse activities with the utmost care, such as counting and checking goods and accurately recording data. 
 

 
• You're a true safety hero and actively contribute to maintaining our high safety standards and promoting a positive work environment. 
 
• You'll collaborate with great colleagues and other departments to ensure smooth production flows. 

Requirements for this adventurous forklift driver role: 

 
• You have a valid forklift certificate OR can demonstrate experience as a forklift driver. 
 

 
• Don't be afraid to brave the cold, as you'll be showcasing your forklift skills in a deep-freeze environment with temperatures down to -18°C. Your forklift cabin is heated! 
 

 
• Your eye for detail and accuracy make you the king/queen of precision work. 
 

 
• You're a true team player and communicate easily with your colleagues. 
 
• You speak fluent English and are willing to learn Dutch. The company offers Dutch lessons before or after your shift.

jobs.occupation: Pilot Line Process Engineer – Atomic Layer Deposition
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

The Pilot Line Engineer is responsible for: 
 
 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention.  

• Troubleshoots issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up.  

• Investigates recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions.  

• Keeps focus on quality and reproducibility, monitoring stability and taking actions in case of process fluctuations.  

• Designs experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation.  

• Works in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• Works in a two-shifts system (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sa/Su) out of 4.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or in Engineering or equal to this by experience, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset.  

• You are able to rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice.  

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude.  

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required.  

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

About the Role
 

At D’Ieteren, we have been moving people forward for more than 200 years. Today, we continue to shape the future of mobility through flexible, innovative and customer-focused solutions.
 

Volkswagen D’Ieteren Finance is the Belgian market leader in financing and mobility services for the vehicle brands of the D’Ieteren Group.
 

We are looking for an experienced 
Technical Application Manager to manage and further develop a portfolio of customer-, dealer- and fleet-facing digital applications.
 

What Will Your Role Involve?
 

You will be responsible for websites, digital portals, pricing and calculation solutions, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations and middleware components.
 

Acting as the link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, Solution Architects, internal IT teams and external partners, you will ensure that the applications meet business needs and remain stable, secure, compliant and future-ready.
 

This is a technical coordination and steering role. You will not develop applications yourself, but you will need a solid IT background to understand technical topics, assess risks, challenge suppliers and translate business requirements into sustainable solutions.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Managing the full lifecycle of the applications in your portfolio. 

• Defining and maintaining the technical roadmap in line with business priorities and enterprise architecture. 

• Ensuring application stability, availability, performance, security and compliance. 

• Overseeing APIs, integrations and middleware services. 

• Assessing the technical impact, risks and dependencies of new initiatives. 

• Coordinating projects, testing, releases and application changes. 

• Steering SaaS providers, implementation partners and other external suppliers. 

• Monitoring service levels, incidents, KPIs and supplier performance. 

• Supporting IAM, PAM and third-party risk-management processes. 

• Maintaining clear and up-to-date application documentation. 

• Identifying opportunities to improve performance, simplify processes and optimise costs.  

 
 

 

Does This Profile Match You?
 
 

• You have at least five years of relevant experience in application management, technical project management, service delivery or technical product management. 

• You have worked with digital platforms, customer portals, SaaS solutions or other business-critical applications. 

• You have a solid understanding of APIs, integrations, middleware and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. 

• You can translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions and confidently challenge external service providers. 

• You understand application lifecycle management, IT service management, security and compliance requirements. 

• You are proactive, structured and highly organised, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently.  

Experience in automotive finance, leasing, fleet management, banking, insurance or another regulated environment is an advantage. You are fluent in English and have a professional level of Dutch or French; knowledge of all three languages is a plus.

jobs.occupation: CE Driver with a valid Code 95
jobs.description:
Fixed Routes | Early Finish | Meaningful Work
 

Do you enjoy starting your day with a good cup of coffee and heading straight out on the road? Then we have the perfect job for you!
 

For a stable and growing organization in the Oedelem region, we are looking for a CE Driver who values structure, independence, and teamwork.
 

You help ensure that hospitals, healthcare facilities, and holiday parks receive clean linen every day. Essential work with a direct impact.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• As a CE Driver, you are a key part of the logistics process:
 
• You start your shift between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM with a fully loaded truck.
 
• You drive a fixed route serving customers (6 to 8 stops per trip).
 
• You deliver clean linen and collect used textiles.
 
• You return to the laundry facility for your next route.
 
• Your role consists of approximately 50% driving and 50% loading/unloading.
 
• You work independently while being part of a supportive team where collaboration is highly valued. 

Who are we looking for as a CE Driver?
 

 
• You hold a CE driving licence with a valid Code 95.
 
• You are hands-on and not afraid of physical work.
 
• You are customer-focused, reliable, and flexible.
 
• You speak Dutch and/or English.
 
• You live within 25 minutes of Oedelem.
 
• You are available to work 37.5 hours per week (4 or 5 days).

Job Responsibilities:
 

1. Payable Accounting: - Checking, booking the invoices , the internal & external staff expenses - Monitoring payments via Isabel - Resolving disputes with suppliers (CN,Reminder,...) - Booking financial transactions and carrying out bank reconciliations
 

2. Year end and monthly closing: Help in preparing the Audit file and financial reports
 

3. Support to Finance & Business Controler: - Preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts by molecule brand and market segment - Prepare profitability analysis by product - Monitor performance by distribution channel - Manage data from pharma-specific systems - Maintain accuracy in product master data - Maintain Excel dashboards tailored to the commercial business units
 

4. Support to Customer Services: Lettering accounts and monitoring debt collection 5. Working on ad-hoc project

Educational background:
 

Bachelor in Accountancy Languages: French, Dutch and good working knowledge of English
 

IT: Good knowledge in Excell, and knowledge in Microsoft Office (Inter)personal
 

skills: Organizational skills, methodical, structured, team player and reliable Other : Knowledge of Oracle abd the Isabel payment module is a plus.

jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support.

 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

 
• You help produce precast concrete elements.
 
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
 
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
 
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
 
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.

 As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

 
• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
 
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
 
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
 
• You can work both independently and in a team.
 
• You work safely and in an orderly way.

Nice-to-haves

 
• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards. 
   
 

•  

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Skilled in DFMEA, DFM, DFA, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. 
   
 

•  

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies. 
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•  

Design tests and prototypes required to validate analyses, and correlate simulation results with experimental data.
   
 

•  

Perform root cause analyzes of product and process issues and provide simulation driven recommendations for design improvements.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.
